# Arcade

> A small browser arcade with Neon Snake, Neon Tetris, and Hacker Typer.

The site is a Next.js application. Each game is available without an account or installation.

## Pages

- [Arcade home](https://arcade.kingironman.dev/): Game selection.
- [Neon Snake](https://arcade.kingironman.dev/snake): A 20×20 wraparound snake game with keyboard controls.
- [Neon Tetris](https://arcade.kingironman.dev/tetris): A neon-styled browser Tetris board.
- [Hacker Typer](https://arcade.kingironman.dev/hacker): A fake terminal that reacts to typing.
